name: @solidjs-components/photo-capture
description: <solid-photo-capture>: photos (and optionally other files) on a record: take, upload or drop them, each uploads straight away (large photos scaled down first), with captions, when and by whom, and a lightbox. Stores fieldtec-web file records, and shows fieldtec-web's own file references (mode view). Replaces sc-uploader for photos.
